name: supporting-information
description: Set up, restructure, or review FAIR, reproducible supporting information for a paper and deposit it on Zenodo.

interface.shortDescription: FAIR, reproducible SI repositories ready for Zenodo.
interface.longDescription: Scaffolds new supporting-information repositories from a template, adapts existing project directories into one without touching the original, and reviews deposits against FAIR, Zenodo and reproducibility checks, including the analysis code.
defaultPrompt: Turn this analysis directory into supporting information for my paper and prepare it for Zenodo.
